contradicting_or_limiting: H25 massage cointervention and uncertain method status

evidence_items.text: 2021 Jing massage-plus-earthing grey report, n=12 with chronic low-back pain: massage in both arms plus grounded versus sham sleep; pain reduction 38 percent versus 17 percent reported.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Tiny, grey, with an active cointervention in both arms and uncertain publication and method status; retained as context only.

evidence_items.text: Sokal et al. 2025 concerns post-lumbar-surgery recovery, an acute surgical context rather than chronic back pain.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Anatomically adjacent but a different clinical condition and timeframe.

evidence_items.text: No separate neck-pain trial was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: One of the two advertised conditions has no evidence at all.

evidence_items.text: No back or neck trial without confounded cointerventions was located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The one back-pain observation cannot separate grounding from massage.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: One confounded grey observation for back pain and no evidence at all for neck pain.
supporting: H25 grey low-back report with massage in both arms

detected.rationale: A benefit for two named chronic conditions is implied from a 12-participant grey report with an active cointervention and an acute postoperative trial.
Acute postoperative lumbar pain is extended to chronic back pain and to neck pain, for which nothing was located.
